name: Photographe de Teyvat/26.08.2022
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ The Sumeru map is now available with the launch of Version 3.0. With the magnificent scenery of lush foliage, new flora and fauna, puzzle-solving gameplay, and fascinating Dendro elemental reactions, a new adventure has begun... Photos are essential to immortalize the good times and thus, I bring you the Sumeru #Photographer of Teyvat event! Take photos in Sumeru according to the designated themes for a chance to win Primogems!
